summary: The Custom operation gains a PostProcessOutput property and task-panel checkbox plus a '!' line prefix that emit lines with a new as-is annotation which the machine-based post-processor passes through unchanged.

pages.reason: Path/Op/Custom.py initOperation adds App::PropertyBool PostProcessOutput (default True); PageOpCustomEdit.ui adds chkAsIs 'Post Process Output' checkbox; processLines treats lines starting with '!' or all lines when PostProcessOutput is off as as-is; File source lines now also get ANNOT_ALLOW_UNSUPPORTED and error messages are reworded
Path/Post/Processor.py _convert_command returns command.Annotations[ANNOT_AS_IS] verbatim before supported-command validation; Constants.py adds ANNOT_AS_IS = 'as-is'
Constants.py adds ANNOT_AS_IS annotation; Custom.py builds Path.Command('', {}, {ANNOT_AS_IS: line}) so the annotation list under The Command object needs the new entry
Processor.py hunk only adds an internal annotation branch in _convert_command; the Post Process dialog, preferences and job properties are untouched
Processor.py change is an internal pass-through branch; nothing on this page about writing or adding a post-processor is affected
